notes.title: PIROFAUNA New Game Announcement
notes.notes:
[h3]Hey Everyone![/h3]
After months of silence and refraining from unnecessary chatter, I can finally share with you the announcement of a new game, PIROFAUNA.

[h3]Check out Reveal Teaser Trailer:[/h3]
[previewyoutube=iaN4coexfMU;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]What is it?[/h3]
In Pirofauna, you are a tiny little flame wandering through a dark misty forest. You can set fire to anything your tail reaches. Light up the darkness, help lost and frightened worms, dispel unfriendly creatures.

This might be called explorative adventure. We will have freedom of movement and the ability to explore the forest with various bug villages.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2984150/Pirofauna/

[h3]How?[/h3]
The game is a huge step up from the 2D world of Papetura. The idea started when I felt too limited by the lack of depth. I built a dark field of grass, illuminated by “some” character that emits light. Everything came together as if the game created itself, and viola, a little Flame was born.

Everything in the game is still made of paper. The creation process has changed a bit, but it still makes me sit up until night cutting out paper sculptures.

The music for the game is composed, as in Papetura, by the wonderful Tomas Dvorak aka Floex. This time he experiments with various small instruments!

[h3]If you liked Papetura, you might like Pirofauna as well!
Please Wishlist on Steam![/h3]
It's the greatest way to support my work, sharing and wishlisting the game, so I kindly ask you to do so! <3

[i]All the best,
Tomasz Ostafin[/i]

notes.title: My Friends Game - Hank: Straightjacket
notes.notes:
Hey Everyone!

As solo dev, I sometimes stumble upon games that are also made by small teams, and I wish to help as much as it is possible, please have a look and let me know if you like it. So..

My friends created this 'micro' adventure game. It’s about a vigilante with time powers trying to survive and It's now available on Steam.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2277670/Hank_Straightjacket/
Let me pass it on to Kuba - the game’s programmer - so he can tell you the story behind the game:


[i]Hey, everybody!
Kuba from My Next Games here. How’s everyone doing in the new year? For us it’s been busy. Last month, we’ve won a for a video game prototype! (I’m the guy in brown pants in the photo) 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43507426/0be4921a44d2d1af3bfa265759a034a1da274408.jpg[/img]

The competition was organized by CRPK Poland and we entered it with a proposal for a small point-and-click game - Hank: Straightjacket. Here’s the story of how this little adventure game came to be:

We were about to start working on a new dialog system for our main project - Hank: Drowning on Dry Land - and we wanted it to be a bit different. In a regular game when the conversation starts the game pauses - you talk to the character and you’re basically unable to do anything else. We want to change this and allow players to interact with the world while still in dialogue. There are some challenges that stem from that approach, though. What happens if the player does something noteworthy during the conversation? Wouldn’t it feel strange if the hero broke a piece of furniture and the npc didn't react to it? We had some ideas on how to tackle those problems but we couldn’t be sure they would work without trying them out in an actual game. And so we went on a rapid prototyping spree…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43507426/f795d7b8e8dc01c2d8dbdbabcb2bd19d58054be2.gif[/img]

…Two weeks and five gallons of coffee later we finally had a build and a working prototype of the system. As a side effect we created this tiny escape room experience. We were quite surprised that it was even playable! So, we called it Hank: Straightjacket and decided to release it as a free game. If you’d like to - giving it a go! Hope you guys enjoy it and if you’re interested in more Hank’s adventure here the link to Hank: Drowning on Dry Land:[/i]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1937880/Hank_Drowning_On_Dry_Land/
[i]Cya Around,
Kuba
[/i]

notes.title: Papetura Update Is Here!
notes.notes:
[b]Hey Everyone,[/b]

For last months I've been working on Papetura major update, and it's finally here!
The main goal was to move the game to the latest version of the engine, and by doing this, resolve many issues with game not running properly. This was also an opportunity to improve many things in Papetura, from visuals to audio, I went over everything one more time.

[b]Here it is, the changelog:[/b]
- Game engine update - fixed issue with Citrix drivers collision, and possibility to more precisely diagnose crashes.
- Improved/fixed some visuals, animations and sounds.
- Image is more crisp, reduced chromatic aberration a little bit.
- Added characters reactions to projectile hits.
- Increased player walk speed over longer distances.
- Monster chase puzzle is getting easier with more tries.
- Dropped support for all 32bit MacOS (due to engine update)
- Other minor bugs & fixes

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35591478/36b275b3391aa71d587017e214bed8cf9ebc9b2d.png[/img]

[b]Have a good time playing or replaying the game!
<3[/b]

[i]PS: If you encounter some game crashes after the update, please try to reinstall the game. Steam updater may unfortunately break some things..[/i]

notes.title: Warm Welcome and Upcoming Updates
notes.notes:
[i][b]Hey Everyone,[/b][/i]

It's been a month since the game's release, so it's time for some news! How has the game been received, how are sales going, and what is the future of Papetura?

[h2]Release[/h2]
Let me start with a Big Thank You to everyone, because the game was very warmly received by you. Summing up, Papetura turned out to be a nice, interesting experience, but quite short with flaws. Waiting for your reviews was terrifying, I knew that I am not a game design master and I still have a lot to learn. In the end, I was very surprised and comforted that most of the players liked the game. I read all your comments and I know that some things I can still improve, but unfortunately some of them I will not able to.

I think the whole experience of designing, developing and publishing the game was amazing. Many years have passed and I have learned quite a lot, I met many interesting and passionate people. On the other hand, it's good that the release of the game is behind me, it was really a crazy idea..

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35591478/b1a608acad7432561735900b9e2908fc563cc87b.png[/img]

[h2]Upcoming Update[/h2]
I am currently improving some of Papetura gameplay elements, those that are unclear or could be made better. As for bugs, there were some and I'm still looking for them. Thanks to you, in the first week, we uncovered some important ones! The game requires an update of the game engine, so script by script I move them over to a newer version to remove errors from the old engine. I have tremendous need to get rid of every bug in the game, so hopefully I can do it.

[h2]Artbook And Soundtrack[/h2]
At the same time, I'm working on an artbook, collecting all the materials I have, sketches, photos and screenshots. It will be arranged reasonably so that you can see how everything was created and how many things weren't used in the game. Such an artbook with a soundtrack will soon be available as a DLC for purchase on Steam!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35591478/c85454b0b134128e2992174defd2bfdaa8aaf86f.png[/img]

[h2]Sales[/h2]
When I was creating a game, year after year, I stopped calculating how much profit it would bring. I realized why I make Papetura and why it is not worth counting on a lot of money when making such an personal and experimental game. I thought it would be a great success if the game would sold 10,000 copies in one year.

I am pleased to tell you that the game is on the right track to get such a result! During the first and most important week, 6,500 players bought the game! Which sounds promising for the coming year.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35591478/f3d3f535e9d3d8c8a4d85082c19cb69db240d84a.png[/img]

[h2]Future[/h2]
In addition to the updates and the artbook, I also work on the Switch port for Papetura. My devkit has arrived so I'll try my hand at getting the game up and running on Switch!
Also, who know what future will bring.. Maybe another game?

[b][i]Thanks again for such a warm welcome!
I will try to make better and better games![/i][/b]

notes.title: Paper is Alive! Papetura is Released!
notes.notes:
Hey Everyone,

[b]After 6 years of development Papetura is finally out![/b]
From the start I want to thank you all for the patience and support <3. The game way delayed many times, but not this time. During final weeks Tomas, Juraj and me were focused strongly only on the game finalisation so marketing might be lacking, but we are happy that the game turned out to be ready for the release.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35591478/73c1ab0ff13cab1bd0e340021e8222df92098f1a.jpg[/img]

Said that, I think we will continue to make the game a little better with following updates. I've done a couple of mini updates sneakily based on you feedback and bugs reports, and I will continue to do that if some new are found.
We are greatly happy that initial feedback from you is positive! It seems that average playtime of the game is around 2 hours, which is nice. It might seem too little for that long development, but it just shows that making the game this way is just insane if playtime is a priority. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35591478/4f4c8218c6de29d0fb232dde9f54da54961b651b.jpg[/img]

Soon we will also release [b]Soundtrack together with Artbook.[/b] I would like to make the artbook to show the story of development, all behind the scenes photos and artworks. It might take around two weeks to gather all the materials in a nice way. I hope you will like it.

notes.title: Gluing and Cutting - Development Update
notes.notes:
[b]Hi everyone![/b]

It's been a while since last update, and I have many news to share with you all!

[h2]The Demo[/h2]
First demo of Papetura was released on Summer Steam Festival! I decided not to take it down after the festival, so you can try it out anytime.
We can call it 'short experience' for now, as it is very short, but you can feel the atmosphere of the paper world.. The whole game won't be that short, please don't worry! I've recently speedrun the game and it took 70min, so usual play-through should take around 2h or more.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35591478/b3053c7cd94491d28799413fd5329f022654d843.jpg[/img]

[h2]Realese Date[/h2]
Unfortunately, Papetura will be delayed a little bit.. Mostly due to delays in development, that are dependent on my well being - as I'm the one making the game, there is no chance for someone to take over. I was also overwhelmed by my main job that I live from, but decided that making the game should be priority for now. There is a little bit more to do, so together with Floex, we decided that the safest release date will be [b]February '21. [/b]
I'm sorry to all of you that are tired of waiting for the game!

[h2]Development[/h2]
First of all, I'm noob when it comes to game industry, but hopefully many people are willing to help and give some advice, so that way the development is moving forward without big mistakes - except of course - dreadful delays.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35591478/076b986e22add29e7621d788f7889908b65d4cab.jpg[/img]

Second of all, saying about the things I might be better at - making the paper model. It's going very well, and I will have it done in the next month. After that I'll focus only on polishing the gameplay, cause I have all of the prototype build already!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35591478/6a05730ff4cd71232a254d84091fa06fe1c72bda.jpg[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35591478/42295691b31970fcf7b2ec2b9146bc02d0c290be.jpg[/img]

Final thing, that makes the paper-world comes to life is music, and from what I've listened to will be very special. Among tracks, there are two that make me cry, and one that cheer me up! Tomas Dvorak is influencing the game in big and positive way, so great thanks to him!

Thank you for your patience!
Tomasz

notes.title: Release Date!
notes.notes:
[h3]I'm sorry to announce to you all that the game release will be delayed to Summer 2020![/h3]
It wasn't planned, but the production went a little bit sideways, and the game needs more work to be most enjoyable and beautiful..

As we are a small team, Floex making the soundtrack, Juraj Mravec making SFX, and me doing visuals and programming, we have decided it would be the best to delay the release date rather than presenting you with the game that isn't yet finished.

To be honest with you, this game is being made with passion and no big money is at stake, so we have no pressure to release something that we are not yest satisfied with..

[h3]I'm very sorry and apologize everyone for inconvenience![/h3]
I hope you understand, and ask you for a little bit more patience,
See you soon in the next update!
